subject: Private deployment pricing: platform fee, burst credits and legal path
messages:
From: Sara Tam <sara.tam@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing: platform fee, burst credits and legal path

Ben —

Thanks for the call this morning. We're close but the procurement team has two sticking points before we can route for final approval: the platform fee amortization (our finance prefers amortized monthly vs. a large up-front fee) and the burst-credit guarantees for peak periods. Legal also asked for a clearer charging point for SRE oncall (we'd like a defined oncall band rather than an open ops retainer).

Requests from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a 36-month amortization option for the platform fee and a monthly invoice schedule?
- Can you quantify the burst-credit model (how many burst-hours per month at no extra cost, and a capped overage rate)?
- Please confirm whether SRE oncall can be scoped as an hourly oncall band (e.g., 40 hours/month included) with overtime billed at a defined rate.

If you send a short write-up we can attach it to the PO and get legal/finance to sign off.

Also attaching our internal procurement checklist (not required back) — FYI.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Tam
Head of Procurement, Novamed
procurement@novamed.com

--
Attachment: Novamed_procurement_checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Tam <sara.tam@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing: platform fee, burst credits and legal path

Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. I've sketched a concise proposal below so your team can attach it to the PO. High-level options we can sign to:

1) Platform fee amortization (pick one):
   - Option A (36-month amortization): Platform fee $360k amortized at $10k/month (invoiced monthly). Upfront only a one-time admin activation invoice: $15k.
   - Option B (12-month amortization): Platform fee $330k amortized monthly $27.5k/month (lower activation: $10k).

2) Burst-credit model:
   - Baseline commit supports 1000 concurrent qps steady-state. We include a monthly burst allowance equivalent to 12,000 burst GPU-minutes (approx. 200 peak minutes/day) at no extra charge.
   - Overage beyond burst allowance billed at $0.20/GPU-minute, capped at $20k/month.

3) SRE oncall:
   - Included: 40 hours/month of oncall support (for escalation triage & runbook ops).
   - Overtime: $180/hour, with a monthly cap of 100 hours unless mutually agreed otherwise.

4) Credits & concessions:
   - If Novamed signs a 36-month term and commits to the platform fee Option A, we can offer a one-time implementation credit of $40k to be applied to the first three invoices.
   - If procurement prefers the 12-month route, implementation credit is $20k.

Attachments: I've attached a draft commercial summary (Novamed-MA-proposal-v2.pdf) that lays this out in a single page and a short invoice/timing table. This is intended for procurement + finance.

Next steps suggestion:
- If this looks acceptable, Marissa and I will push a cleaned PDF to legal for redlines and prepare a DocuSign link for the commercial terms.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow if you want to walk it through.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

--
Attachment: Novamed-MA-proposal-v2.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Tam <sara.tam@novamed.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing: platform fee, burst credits and legal path

Sara —

Following Ben's note, two pragmatic suggestions from our side to accelerate legal/finance:

- We can convert the implementation credit into a refundable invoice credit on day 30 if that helps Novamed's cashflow team (i.e., it posts as a credit memo rather than an offset).
- For SRE oncall clarity: we'll include a 30-day SLA appendix that defines response windows for Sev1/Sev2/Sev3 and the hours included in the 40-hour bucket. That tends to satisfy legal concerns about open retainer language.

Irene — can you confirm engineering is comfortable with the 12,000 monthly burst GPU-min allowance and the $0.20/GPU-minute overage cap?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Sara Tam <sara.tam@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Novamed Legal <legal@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 07:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing: platform fee, burst credits and legal path

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks, this is exactly the level of detail we need. A few clarifying points from our legal/finance review:

1) Finance prefers Option A (36-month amortization) but requests the implementation credit be split across the first 6 invoices instead of the first 3 — can Redwood accommodate?
2) Legal asked for an absolute monthly overage cap clause in the main commercial terms (not just in the invoice appendix). The cap language should state: "Customer overage liability shall not exceed $20,000 USD per calendar month."
3) Legal also requested the SLA appendix specify that oncall hours included do not roll over month-to-month and that any emergency oncall requiring more than 24 continuous hours constitutes an "Incident" that triggers the incident management process and potential credit.

Attached is our PO draft and a short procurement signature sheet — once your legal teams accept the cap and the invoice spread we can attach the PO and move to signature.

Thanks,
Sara

--
Attachment: Novamed_PO_12345.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Tam <sara.tam@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing: platform fee, burst credits and legal path

Sara —

Great, glad we're aligned. Confirmations:
- We can split the $40k implementation credit across the first 6 invoices for Option A (36 months).
- We'll add the explicit overage cap clause to the commercial terms exactly as requested: "Customer overage liability shall not exceed $20,000 USD per calendar month."
- We'll include the SLA appendix language that oncall hours do not roll over and that >24 continuous emergency hours triggers the incident process.

Irene has confirmed engineering is comfortable with the 12,000 monthly burst GPU-minute allowance and the overage rate/cap. Irene — appreciate a one-line confirmation here for legal.

Next steps:
1) We'll upload an updated commercial summary and SLA appendix to the HubSpot deal and share the DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.
2) If Novamed wants a short call with legal to review the exact phrasing, we can schedule a 30-min slot tomorrow afternoon (available 2–4pm PT).

If that all looks good I'll mark this as ready for signature.

Thanks,
Ben
